title: Stored event
description: One event as a read returns it, which is what a dry run previews. This is not the wire event: capture, redaction and masking have been applied, and unknown fields are gone.

eventTimestamp.description: Normalized to UTC and stored to millisecond precision.

receivedAt.description: When the server received it. Omitted from a dry run's preview, which received nothing.

inputPayload.description: After this environment's capture policy and redaction.

payloadDiff.description: Computed after capture, only when both payloads are present.

error.description: Masked by shape. The stack is dropped unless full capture is in effect.

displayValue.description: Masked, because an alias may be an identifier the caller is not entitled to see in full, unless displayable is true. Null when the key that encrypted it is no longer held.

displayable.description: True when every event that stated this alias listed it in displayableAliases; displayValue is then the whole value.

aliases.description: The aliases this event stated, each as the journey read shows it, masked the same way. Empty when it stated none. Null when the server did not record which aliases it stated, as for an event stored before that was recorded.
